input.text: I support cost's motion, with one amendment. Cross-family review is the right default, and it is what my vantage asks for. Three points. First, "another model family" is a weaker guarantee than "not the author." The reviewer should also not share the author's context, drafts or prior conclusions, or it will tend to inherit the author's framing. Second, the reviewer must check specific claims against the artifacts, not just read the plan and judge it plausible. Third, the reviewer's findings should go back to the author, and the author must not mark them resolved alone. Otherwise the author becomes the checker again. On the council question I agree with cost and fam: escalate only when the reviewer finds a structural or normative disagreement. A council of one family should not be counted as verification. If the motion is amended to include these three conditions, I would vote yes.
